description.description: What the view is for, in 5-10 words. The user sees it on the card.

containers.description: By exact name. Omit for the default container.

previous.description: The instance before the last restart.

filters.description: Keep only lines from nodes with these names, or region, zone, os or arch labels.

grep.description: A regular expression the message must match.

anchor.description: tail (the default), head, an RFC 3339 time, or an ISO 8601 duration back from now such as PT15M.

pin_to_end.description: Keep the newest line in view. Default false; true to tail.
